### fak compaction trims ~a third of a turn's resident context per fire (guard passthrough)
<a id="claim-compaction-shed-per-fire"></a>

> **~107K tokens shed per compaction fire on the longest 2026-07-06 session (48K budget), firing repeatedly as the session grows; that trim recurs as a per-turn input saving on top of the provider prompt-cache discount. Fleet fak-authored share of total saved token-equiv ~0.3–16% (2026-W28 pooled ~16.4%). Longest 2026-07-06 session 21:58:33Z = 746,956 shed over 7 fires ≈ 106,708/fire.**

- **status** · ✅ live — a current, committed number backed by a resolvable artifact
- **provenance** · measured — wall-clock throughput/latency measurement
- **model** · fak manage -- claude passthrough, Anthropic prompt cache
- **baseline** · per-fire shed = distinct middle-turn tokens dropped on one compaction fire; fleet share = WITNESSED fak-authored token-equiv / (OBSERVED provider prompt-cache + fak), from fak cachevalue report owner-attribution
- **commit** · `this commit`
- **artifact** · `docs/nightrun/cache-savings.jsonl`
- **reproduce** · `fak cachevalue report (owner-attribution + fleet-benefit); fold compaction_shed_tokens/compaction_fired per generated_at from the ledger`
- **issue** · [#2794](https://github.com/anthony-chaudhary/fak/issues/2794)
- **⚠️ retraction** · A prior version of this row claimed a per-session ~15%→~75% share — RETRACTED as a double-counting artifact
- **fences**
  - compaction_shed_tokens is CUMULATIVE across fires (internal/gateway/metrics.go:645 m.compactShed += out.ShedTokens)
  - Each fire re-trims the client's FULL re-sent history (anthropic_compact.go:440-443, messages.go:814 — fak keeps no compacted body, only a restore tombstone), so the same aged middle turns are dropped and counted on EVERY subsequent fire
  - The session-total 746,956 exceeds the session's live-context ceiling (~250–300K: cache_read 247,074 + cache_creation 112,957 + input 6,227) by ~4.8× — it is NOT a distinct-token count
  - Ratioing shed against cache_read_tokens (a different cumulative sum, per-turn reused-prefix in a different currency) is not a like-for-like share
  - Fence (1): cite shed per fire (divide compaction_shed_tokens by compaction_fired), never the session sum, and never as a share of cache_read
  - Fence (2): the report prices shed at its honest PROPORTIONAL blend saved_token_equiv = min(shed, cache_read)×0.1 + (shed − min)×1.0 — the warm portion the provider evidenced as cache_reads at 0.1×, the cold remainder at 1.0× — via cacheprice.ShedTokenEquiv (internal/cacheprice/cacheprice.go) and NewSavingsRows (internal/cachevaluereport/track2.go:437-438); each row stamped CACHE_READ_MARGINAL (wholly warm) / FULL_INPUT (wholly cold) / BLENDED_MARGINAL (mixed) via shedValuationBasis (track2.go:462); LANDED 627001df
  - The pre-fix all-1.0× saved_token_equiv = shed over-credited warm fires ~10×, and the aggregate-warm binary fix that followed then UNDER-credited a cold-dominant session ~10× on a single warm token; BOTH step functions are retired on all three surfaces (#2794/#2798/#2804): the Track-2 report, the live guard-exit/metrics split, and the sessionobs net-true ledger now price shed through the one cacheprice.ShedTokenEquiv blend
  - Fence (3): fak-AUTHORED, on top of the provider discount — never attribute the provider slice to fak
